fixes.explanation: Useless is a harsh word, and Paul doesn't use it. When he does what he doesn't want to do, he says, “…I admit that the law is good.” Right in the middle of his struggle, he still sides with the law. He doesn't pin his trouble on it.

Pride is a fair guess, friend, but it's not the word on the page. Paul says, “…it is sin living in me that does it.” Notice the picture he paints: sin is the one living in him and doing it. Pride isn't named anywhere in these verses, so sin is the word Paul points to.
